product.name: Slim-Fit Sports Joggers with DryMove™
product.description: Slim-fit sports joggers in functional fabric made with DryMove™ to wick away moisture from skin and keep you comfortably dry while moving. Elasticized, drawstring waistband, side pockets with a taped zipper, and tapered legs.

materialDetails.name: Livaeco™ Viscose
materialDetails.description: Livaeco™ viscose is a branded viscose fiber, made from wood pulp.

materialDetails.name: Polyester
materialDetails.description: Polyester is a synthetic fiber made from crude oil (a fossil resource).

materialDetails.name: Rayon
materialDetails.description: Viscose is a regenerated cellulose fiber commonly made from wood, but the raw material could also consist of other cellulosic materials.

materialDetails.name: Recycled polyester
materialDetails.description: Recycled polyester is polyester made from PET bottles or end-of-life textile waste. The PET bottles or textile waste is mechanically recycled and processed into new yarn.

materialDetails.name: Spandex
materialDetails.description: Elastane is an elastic synthetic fiber made from oil (a fossil resource).
